function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to a specified URL. This function is used to retrieve data from a specified resource in the SCE API portal. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL of the SCE API endpoint, such as 'https://sweweb/sce-api/product/volume-products', which represents the volume products endpoint.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request, typically 'application/json'.

timeout.description: The maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the server to send data before giving up, e.g., 30.5 seconds. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

days.description: Retrieve query results starting from this many days ago up to today.

end_date.description: The end date to get valid volume products, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

allow_redirects.description: Whether the request should follow HTTP redirects.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials as a (username, password) tuple or null to indicate no authentication.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file as a string, or a tuple of ('cert.pem', 'key.pem') for both cert and key files, or null for no client certificate.

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: The URL of the proxy server for HTTP requests, such as 'http://10.10.1.10:3128'.

https.description: The URL of the proxy server for HTTPS requests, such as 'https://10.10.1.11:1080'.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be immediately downloaded.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.
